draft_notice.what: pre-registration DRAFT for the independent-information (data-window) probe; it is not registered, carries no timestamp of registration and licenses nothing
draft_notice.may_be_registered_only_by: the captain, after user approval and machine confirmation
draft_notice.registration_instruction: 等待用户批准 + 机器确认后由队长指示注册；本文件在注册前不得被引用为预登记，也不得据此开跑任何训练

motivation.source: t21 upper-bound probe (runs/training-in-sample-probe-20261027/, plan sha d03e00f8…) relayed by the captain
motivation.reading: in-sample RankIC rises monotonically with the budget and the in-sample budget-point differences exclude zero (5.28-2.64 +0.06384 [0.04622, 0.08543]), so the recipe can fit the training window; out-of-sample falls monotonically, so the binding constraint is independent information rather than capacity or optimization
motivation.honest_bound: only the 5.28 point is a determined overfit; 1.32 and 2.64 are intermediate/inconclusive. The probe therefore runs where the regime is intermediate, and the expected effect is a shift of the whole in-sample/out-of-sample gap curve, not the rescue of one determined-overfit point
motivation.why_a_data_window_and_not_more_training: t5 measured all three budget points on the 60-day window: every additional doubling lowered the out-of-sample primary metric with an interval entirely below zero, and the budget rule v2 refuses further training amount

single_factor: the size of the training window only (how many trading days of history feed the same recipe); the trunk, features, labels, loss, sampling, learning-rate rule, budget points and evaluation window stay frozen

ladder.window_note: the cited reference config uses 2023-05-05..2023-11-01, which is exactly 120 trading days, not 132; 132 trading days ending 2023-10-31 starts at 2023-04-14. The registered value must be one of the two and must be written down before registration (see open_items)

ladder.trigger: level 1 clears the escalation rule below
ladder.note: level 2 is a separate registration and is not licensed by level 1's registration

escalation_rule.proposed: escalate to level 2 only if level 1 reaches the v2 state still_improving against its 60-day control: paired improvement >= 0.0017, 5-day block interval lower bound > 0, and at least 4 of the 5 declared periods positive
escalation_rule.why_not_fixed: the value is the registered screening floor and is used here on purpose, but the captain has not ratified escalating on the screening floor rather than on the promotion floor 0.0034; the draft does not decide it

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the pre-registered trajectory steps govern the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as an upper bound above the last budget point
budget_only_overrides.data.splits.train.start: moved earlier by the declared window; this is the single changed factor
budget_only_overrides.note: any other deviation from configs/mlplob_v3_60d_csz_19800.json must fail the run guard

steps_and_cost.do_not_hardcode: the step time and the window stay provisional until the t22 profiling conclusion lands; nothing here may be pasted into a registered document unchanged

usable_sample_estimate.method: usable_samples scale with the number of trading days at a fixed 8 sample times and universe

validated_at_60_days.note: the scaling reproduces the measured 19,777 steps exactly, so it is a calibrated estimate and still only an estimate

step_time.source: t4 cloud run: 3002.56 s wall over 79,106 steps (runs/training-trajectory-20261027/20261027T124332.686678Z_d2da968fc909 manifest wall_seconds)
step_time.superseded_by: t22 training-step profile (in progress); the registered cost estimate must be recomputed from t22
step_time.note: these minute figures are the captain's ~55 min estimate reproduced; they are not a budget commitment

controls.rule: the control for every level-1 arm is the 60-day arm at the same budget point, evaluated on the identical declared months with the identical estimator

comparisons.question: does a longer training window help at the same budget, with no extra training
does the point where extra training stops paying move right when the sample grows
comparisons.isolates: training-window size only, at the second budget point

comparisons.question: with more independent information, does a further doubling still pay
comparisons.isolates: budget only, inside the enlarged window

interval.method: consecutive trading-day blocks inside each declared period, never crossing a gap

decision.secondary_and_net5: reported alongside and compared against the registered secondary lines and the net5 limit; 5bp stays a locked stress gate and is never a positive promotion condition
decision.promotion: this probe screens; promotion still needs scripts/promotion_gate.py under min_improvement 0.0034 against the incumbent baseline, and a three-seed aggregate

evaluation.why_these: the five declared research months of the registered b4 pre-registration; the enlarged training window ends 2023-10-31 so every evaluated day stays out of sample

boundaries.single_seed: screening only; any candidate that must pass the gate has to be completed to the three seeds of the baseline family

open_items_before_registration: choose the window: 120 trading days (exactly the existing configs/model_v2_120d_csz.json window) or 132 trading days (2023-04-14..2023-10-31); the captain's draft says 132 and the cited reference window is 120
re-pin the step time from the t22 training-step profile and recompute the cost estimate; the 37.96 ms/step figure is the t4 observation, not a promise
ratify or replace the escalation rule (screening floor 0.0017 versus promotion floor 0.0034)
re-derive usable samples for the chosen window at run time; the driver already re-derives steps from the pool actually built, and the registered document must say that the estimate is not the budget

re-measure training memory for the enlarged pool on the cloud host: the 60-day window tensors were 2.95 GB of a 19,584 MB peak, and the enlarged pool is about 2.2x (132d) or 4x (240d); the 24 GiB line still applies only to the inference/submission path, so this is a capacity question for the training host and must be stated as such
decide whether level 2 needs its own escalation rule or simply repeats level 1's
confirm that the level-1 arms are compared against the existing 60-day replays rather than re-running the 60-day control
prohibitions: no registration, no training and no probe run from this draft
no hardcoding of the step time, the wall-clock budget or the exact window before t22 and the captain's approval
no change to any promotion threshold, secondary line, net5 limit, evidence rule or period declaration
no reading of the sealed interval, at any level
no claim that more training helps: the budget direction was refused in t5 and this probe tests data, not budget
no reporting of a single-seed arm as a candidate; the gate needs a three-seed aggregate
no relaxation of the 5bp stress scenario and no treatment of a cost-scenario result as a primary-metric result
